profile.headline: Zerotouch Lead Software Engineer at Dell Technologies.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Drive end-to-end software development processes, from architectural planning and design to deployment and maintenance, ensuring high-quality and scalable solutions.
Lead cross-functional teams in building robust, efficient, and maintainable software systems using modern frameworks as Python FastAPI, Go Gin and cloud technologies as Kubernetes.
Collaborate closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, define technical roadmaps, and deliver innovative solutions aligned with business objectives.
Champion best practices in code quality, testing, CI/CD, and agile development.
Mentor junior engineers, conduct code reviews, and foster a collaborative, high-performance engineering culture.
Skilled in full-stack development, microservices architecture, DevOps practices, and cloud platforms.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and implement automated provisioning for multi-site datacenter infrastructure, increasing capacity for customers while reducing deployment time and minimizing human error.
Architect microservices-based applications with RESTful APIs to enhance scalability and reduce system downtime in the deployed infrastructure.
Conduct architectural reviews to identify system bottlenecks and propose optimization strategies for improved performance and reliability.
Perform proof-of-concept (PoC) experiments to evaluate emerging technologies and assess their fit for project requirements.
Develop and maintain high-performance function-based code using Go, deployed over serverless platforms in Kubernetes.
Build and support robust, efficient, and reusable microservices using Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and AWX Ansible.
Design and implement cloud-native application architectures leveraging Kubernetes for scalability and cost efficiency.
Create and deploy comprehensive CI/CD pipelines for microservices, utilizing version control systems like Git.
Implement automated testing plans and code coverage practices to ensure product reliability and maintainability.
Collaborate with team members and cross-functional teams to gather requirements, share ideas and ensure alignment with project goals.
Implement monitoring dashboards, metric instrumentation, workflow, and alerting systems using Prometheus, Loki, and Grafana to track performance and proactively address potential issues.

positions.title: Software Engineer and System Administration.
positions.description:
Oversee software development's lifecycle with Agile SCRUM methodology.
Full-stack programmer in Python, HTML5, CSS, JQuery, React.
Implement CI/CD for software development at the City of Homestead to support process automation for the employees, creation of pipeline in Azure DevOps with predefined tasks or YAML files.
Implementing the development process to use automated testing during the development process.
Develop unit testing technologies like JUnit for Java, PHPUnit for PHP. Automated frontend testing expertise with IBM Rational Functional Tester and Selenium.
Implement automated unit testing in the Azure Pipeline DevOps with YAML files.
Responsible for designing, building, configuring, maintaining, troubleshooting and
programming systems to support the operation of the government institution of The City
of Homestead.
Head Design Engineer of the new City of Homestead Data Center, which holds the
network, hardware, and software to support 400+ employees and 68000+ residents.
Oversaw the project’s budget, in some cases, readjusting it according to the need without
compromising the project.
Managed time and work of the project, as wells as the personnel that was working on a
project.
Strong ability to identify and troubleshoot any system’s or connectivity issues.
Installing, configuring, and troubleshooting Cisco equipment switches, routers, and
firewalls.
I also implemented cybersecurity systems, for web filtering, spam filtering, and network monitoring.
Configuration of multiples OS like Windows, Mac OS, Linux. Installing and maintenance
of software and hardware.
Provided high quality of customer service.

positions.title: Software Developer and System Administration
positions.description:
Involve in the entire lifecycle of the development of software, from the capture of requirements to deployment and maintenance.
Full-stack programming software in ColdFusion, HTML5, SCC, JQuery.
Warranty high quality of the product.
Work on CI/CD and system automation.
Modeling the business process to deploy the management system digital documents, specific on ImageNow/Onbase, installing and maintenance services to improve the workflow of the employee of the institution. Technical support to the different servers and services on the network for the College of Business.

positions.title: Electronic Technician
positions.description:
Electronic Technician. Responsible for installing, repairing and maintain specialized bar code scanners, computers and networking devices, printers, IP phones.
Repair and configuration of bar code scanner. Multiples brand like Symbol/Motorola, all models (9060, 9090, 3090, etc.), all those flavors, installing and maintenance of inventory/track software. Important customers like Jo-Ann Fabric, Men Warehouse, Ryder and many more.
 Configuration and maintenance of hardware and software of computers.

positions.title: Software Developper and Network Administrator.
positions.description:
Contribute to software engineering expertise in the development of products through the software lifecycle, from requirements definition through successful deployment.
Full-stack developer with technologies like PHP, Python, HTML, CSS, JQuery (JavaScript).
Adopting and encourage the team to take and implement the latest methodologies of software design and development.
Creation and maintenance of software for automated processes.
Creation and maintenance of quality user documentation and developer documentation for the product created. 
Implementation of APIs in Python and interaction with third-party APIs to ensure communication among all systems.  
Responsible for the administration and troubleshooting of servers such as virtualization server(VMware), Apache2, PHP, MySQL, PostgresSQL, MDeamon and Postfix mail servers, mail distributors MTA, Squid proxy server, BIND9 DNS server, OpenSIP VoIP server, and FTPD FTP server. 
Full administration and configuration running under Ubuntu Linux and Windows.
Configuration of Cisco router 2600, 2800, 2900 and IOS 12.x version.
Configuration of Cisco Catalyst Switch 6500 series.
Configuration of Cisco IP Phone.
Configuration of Windows Server 2008 (IIS, Email server, Active Directory) 
Installation and configuration of Firewall for network security, Wi-Fi, dial-up services, and AAA servers for network access with FreeRadius server, video surveillance IP in both cabled and wireless environments.
Provide a high level of customer support and ensure user satisfaction.
